title: Ravi's chair workshop
body: Ravi runs a small workshop that makes wooden chairs. In the short run his workshop rent and machine hire together cost him Rs 60, whatever number of chairs he makes; this is his total fixed cost. To make more chairs he must hire more labour and buy more wood. His accountant records the short run marginal cost of each additional chair as follows: 1st chair Rs 40, 2nd chair Rs 30, 3rd chair Rs 20, 4th chair Rs 30 and 5th chair Rs 50. The accountant reminds him that in the short run the sum of marginal costs up to any output gives the total variable cost at that output, and that total cost is total variable cost plus total fixed cost.
